title: Migratory Burchell's zebra (Equus burchellii) in northern Botswana
place: Okavango Delta to Makgadikgadi grasslands, northern Botswana
citation_as_given: Bartlam-Brooks HLA, Harris S. 2013. Data from: In search of greener pastures: using satellite images to predict the effects of environmental change on zebra migration. Movebank Data Repository. https://doi.org/10.5441/001/1.f3550b4f
paper_citation_as_given: Bartlam-Brooks HLA, Beck PSA, Bohrer G, Harris S (2013) In search of greener pastures—using satellite images to predict the effects of environmental change on zebra migration. Journal of Geophysical Research: Biogeosciences v 188, p 1–11. doi:10.1002/jgrg.20096
method: GPS collar (Vectronic Aerospace GPS-Plus 4D), fixes hourly or every 15 minutes
time_convention: Times are as recorded by the study: UTC, or GPS time, which differs from UTC by a few leap seconds (source README).
